title: feeder tests use thread::sleep and a 5 s wall-clock wait_until
effect: AGENTS.md rule 'tests are deterministic, no sleeps/timeouts' broken; flaky on a loaded CI box
fix: drive run() directly with a fake sink/sender as the Refusing tests already do

title: StreamShared::stopped AtomicBool is a stage flag set from stop(), end(), on_stopped() and the failed-start path
trigger: share a window on macOS, close it while the user also presses stop
effect: none today (swap makes Ended once); Windows twin uses CaptureStage enum, mac keeps a bool
fix: reuse the CaptureStage Live/Stopped cell shared with screen_win

title: StreamFeeder::drain drops the time requests waiting in StreamsSync::Asking without answering them, though its doc says no engine request is left waiting
trigger: RTMP stream, a time request is waiting on getGroupCallStreams, the call is replaced (rejoin) and drain runs
effect: the time waiters (BroadcastRequestId) are forgotten, never answered; harmless only because the old native instance is destroyed right after
fix: answer the waiters with 0 in drain (answer_time_waiters) before setting StreamsSync::Idle

title: WatchStage::Reopened is terminal after a reopen that worked: a second output failure later in the same stream is never healed
trigger: stream plays, output fails once and the reopen works, the device drops again 10 minutes later
effect: stream stays silent until the call window closes; observe() returns None forever from Reopened/GaveUp
fix: leave Reopened back to Watching once the reopened output has shown sound (health.frames advanced), so the rule is per output, not per stream

title: child_timeout tests sleep 100 ms and assert on wall-clock elapsed time while real `sleep 30` children run
trigger: cargo test child_timeout on a loaded CI box
effect: AGENTS.md 'tests are deterministic, no sleeps or wall-clock waits' is broken; elapsed < 5 s asserts can flake
fix: drive wait_within with a fake child or a manual clock; assert on the kill, not on elapsed time

title: ReplacementProbe::Staged is an in-flight-looking stage (is_pending) that holds no task: it relies on the caller to start the probe in the same call
trigger: stage_edit_replacement stages a video; probe_edit_replacement returns early (no pending edit, or the replacement was swapped) before it sets Probing
effect: none today because both callers call probe_edit_replacement right after staging; a new caller that stages without probing leaves Save waiting on is_pending() forever
fix: stage and probe as one step: construct Probing{job} when the replacement is staged, or have for_kind return NotNeeded|Probing only

title: EditImageFetch::Downloading names a download by FileId and holds no request or task; the wait ends only through a per-frame poll (edit_image_upkeep: landed or downloads.gave_up(file_id))
trigger: Edit Image on a photo that is not on disk, the download tracker drops the transfer without recording a give-up
effect: the edit keeps Downloading: Edit Image shows as busy until the edit ends; nothing wakes the upkeep if no frame is drawn
fix: hold the user download's RequestId (or the tracker's handle) in Downloading and settle it from the download answer, not from a frame poll

title: ComposerSnapshot carries bare chat_id: i64 and view_generation: u64 with no account in the key
trigger: submit in account A, switch to account B before the background prepare lands (PreparedMedia::prepare then with_prepared)
effect: none found: the driver of the account that captured it sends it; the owner is implied by which driver receives it, not by the value
fix: AccountChat key (src/ids.rs) in the snapshot so a snapshot cannot be handed to another account's driver
